info.title: Travelo Partner API
info.description:
Partner-facing Tour API contract. Used by @theonedigi/tour-sdk for TypeScript/Zod generation.
---
# Webhooks

This API sends signed POST requests to the partner's registered `webhook_url`.
Every payload is HMAC-SHA256 signed with the same scheme as the REST endpoints.

## Refund Events

### `booking.refunded`
Fires when: Admin approves the refund.
Booking status becomes `5` (Refunded).
Payload contains a `refund` object with `status = 3` (Approved).

### `refund.disapproved`
Fires when: Admin disapproves the refund.
Booking status stays unchanged (In Progress).
Payload contains a `refund` object with `status = 4` (Disapproved).

### Common Webhook Payload Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `event` | string | Event type identifier |
| `product_type` | string | Always `"tour"` |
| `order_code` | string | The booking order code |
| `status` | integer | Booking status code |
| `status_text` | string | Human-readable booking status |
| `total` | float | Booking total in base currency |
| `currency` | string | Base currency code |
| `commission.rate` | integer | Partner commission percentage |
| `commission.amount` | float | Commission amount in base currency |
| `product.code` | string | Tour code |
| `product.name` | string | Tour name |
| `product.departure_date` | string | Departure date (Y-m-d) |
| `customer.name` | string | Customer name |
| `customer.email` | string | Customer email |
| `refund.id` | integer | Refund record ID (refund events only) |
| `refund.refund_total` | float | Refund amount in base currency |
| `refund.status` | integer | Refund status: 1=New, 2=Pending, 3=Approved, 4=Disapproved |
| `refund.status_text` | string | Human-readable refund status |
| `refund.reasons` | string | Reason for the refund |
| `refund.feedback_manager` | string\|null | Admin feedback (if processed) |
| `timestamp` | integer | UNIX timestamp when the webhook was sent |

> **Note:** All monetary values (`total`, `commission.amount`, `refund_total`)
> are in the booking's base currency (`USD`).

parameters.name: X-Partner-Client-Id
parameters.description: The partner's API client ID.

parameters.name: X-Partner-Timestamp
parameters.description: UNIX timestamp of the request (seconds). Max clock skew allowed is 300 seconds. (time = Date.now() / 1000)

parameters.name: X-Partner-Signature
parameters.description:
Hex HMAC-SHA256 of: clientId + "
" + timestamp + "
" + METHOD + "
" + pathWithoutQuery + "
" + sha256(rawBody). Example: POST http://localhost/api/partner/bookings/BKG123456/cancel signs path api/partner/bookings/BKG123456/cancel with empty-body SHA256 e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855. Do not include domain or query string.

parameters.name: X-Currency
parameters.description: Display/input currency for price filters and responses. Defaults to USD.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Preferred locale for localized labels/messages when supported. Recognises en and vi; anything else falls back to en.

parameters.name: X-Partner-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry-safe key for POST /bookings: the same key returns the existing booking instead of creating a second one. Also accepted as the `idempotency_key` body field, which takes precedence. Ignored by every other endpoint. Generate and persist it BEFORE calling — a create that times out has an unknown outcome, and the key is what makes retrying safe.

post.summary:
Requests a refund for the paid booking, or updates the pending one: a partner that reviews
refunds itself sends each step, `refund_total` (the amount it means to refund, at most the
booking total; the whole total when left out) and `feedback_staff` (its staff's review)

post.summary:
The booking's customer reviews its tour. The partner decides when its customer may, even
before the tour (the service, the site): the review belongs to the tour, as one written on
the website does, and the booking only names the tour and its user. `reviewer_name` is who
the partner site knows the reviewer as, shown instead of that user's name. Photos are files
uploaded first through `uploads/pre-signed-url`

post.summary:
The partner has refunded its customer and decided the amount itself: the refund is recorded
as approved, with no review at Travelo, and the paid booking becomes Refunded, as an admin
approval does. `refund_total` is in the booking's currency, at most its total. The partner
sends the whole refund to keep: the customer's `reasons`, its staff's `feedback_staff` and
the approver's `feedback_manager` (the `reasons` when left out)
